args.cmd:
git --no-optional-locks status --short --untracked-files=no
$statusCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('GIT_STATUS_EXIT='+$statusCode)
git branch --show-current
$branchCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('GIT_BRANCH_EXIT='+$branchCode)
git rev-parse HEAD
$headCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('GIT_HEAD_EXIT='+$headCode)
git diff --cached --name-only
$indexCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('GIT_INDEX_EXIT='+$indexCode)
if ($statusCode -ne 0) {exit $statusCode}
if ($branchCode -ne 0) {exit $branchCode}
if ($headCode -ne 0) {exit $headCode}
exit $indexCode
